previous.observation: Fresh root actual native raw/full white/black, old06 full raw/white/black, original PV pose guide, latest user306x170 structure and R21 hair-only crop viewed. New broad gray continuous front/return, subdued mint and outward rebound are readable and uniformly unlit, not rejected for no visible holes. Body/head tilt/half-open solid eye symbols/white glints/small neutral closed mouth/both curled fingers and crossed bent arms/full costume/rear bentleg/other leg/shoes broadly retain original performance. P1 root-placement: two red beads now sit high on IMAGE RIGHT upper bob/temple, above adjacent ear and right pupil, whereas old correct06 gray identity root was below/behind ear near lower bob/nape. The user geometry image was copied with attachment position instead of retargeting to existing identity. Outward bounce is appropriate here but must pivot from lower anatomical LEFT nape root, not temple. Fix next attempt by changing reference hypothesis: old06 correct-root whole as EDIT TARGET and source pose, user reference cropped to turns excluding beads/head; retain substantial broad opaque gray returns and natural compression instead of forcing3holes. Do not mirror body or splice separate curl. Current returned rejected candidate preserved, no dynamic/user pass.
